name: Bone Broth (Base)
recipe_components: Apple Cider Vinegar (97.5g) | Beef Leg Bones (6000g) | Carrots (600g) | Celery (300g) | Cinnamon (10g) | Loomi (Black Lime) (30g) | Turmeric (15g) | Water (Filtered) (15200g) | White Onion (900g)
description: Fully defatted, strained beef bone broth from cracked leg bones with cinnamon, black lemon (loomi), and turmeric — batch yields 10 L (20 × 500 ml cups). Nutrition is for finished skimmed broth per 100 ml, not raw marrow or vegetable solids.
instructions:
Step 1: The Large-Scale Roast — Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Arrange the 6 kg of cracked leg bones across multiple baking sheets so they are not crowded. Roast for 35–40 minutes until deeply browned and fragrant.
Step 2: Vessel Selection & Simmer — You will need a very large stockpot (at least 20 to 24 quarts / liters in capacity) to hold the bones and 15.2 liters of water. Combine the roasted bones, apple cider vinegar, water, cinnamon, loomi (black lemon), and turmeric. Bring to a boil, then immediately turn down to the lowest stovetop setting. Cover with a lid slightly ajar and simmer for 24 to 36 hours.
Step 3: Aromatic & Strain — Add your 6 onions, carrots, and celery for the final 4 hours of the simmer. Strain the massive volume of liquid through a fine-mesh sieve into large, heat-safe containers.
Step 4: The 20-Serving Calorie Lock — Because beef leg bones contain a high volume of marrow, this batch will generate a very thick layer of hard white beef tallow on top. Refrigerate the strained liquid overnight. Once completely chilled, scrape away 100% of the solid fat crust. Your remaining 10 liters of broth will be a dense, jiggly, calorie-controlled gelatin.

name: Turmeric Rice (Base)
recipe_components: Basmati White (200g) | Sea Salt (2g) | Turmeric Powder (4g) | Water (Filtered) (400g)
description: Bright, golden-hued long grain basmati rice steamed with aromatic ground turmeric root and balanced with sea salt.
instructions:
Step 1: Rinse white basmati rice thoroughly under cold water, then soak it overnight in plenty of cold filtered water. (Soak overnight for better nutrient absorption by deactivating phytic acid, to improve digestibility, remove bitterness, and to reduce cooking time.)
Step 2: Drain the soaked rice and rinse briefly.
Step 3: In a small saucepan, combine the drained rice, filtered water, ground turmeric powder, and sea salt, stirring once to distribute the golden spice evenly.
Step 4: Bring the pot to a rolling boil over high heat, then immediately reduce the heat to low, cover with a tight-fitting lid, and let steam undisturbed for 15 minutes until fluffy.

name: Zucchini Almond Bread (Base)
recipe_components: Almond Flour (120g) | Almond whole (30g) | Baking Powder (5g) | Baking Soda (3g) | Date Syrup (25g) | Eggs (Large) (100g) | Ghee (40g) | Psyllium Husks (12g) | Rosemary (Fresh) (3g) | Sea Salt (3g) | Thyme (Fresh) (2g) | Zucchini (150g)
description: Savory gluten-free zucchini almond bread with psyllium, date syrup, ghee, thyme, and rosemary.
instructions:
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a loaf pan with parchment.
Step 2: Whisk the almond flour, psyllium husks, baking powder, baking soda, thyme, ground rosemary, and sea salt together in a large bowl.
Step 3: In another bowl, whisk the eggs, melted ghee, and date syrup until smooth.
Step 4: Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients. Grate and squeeze excess moisture from the zucchini, then fold in the grated zucchini and chopped almonds.
Step 5: Transfer to the prepared pan and bake for 40 minutes until set and golden.
Step 6: Cool completely in the pan, then slice.
